name: The Groozle
source:
See if you can defeat the evil Groozle armed only with a bag of sugary snacks and your cunningest cunning. A simple fantasy adventure game aimed at younger players.

[From [url=https://renai.us/game/the_groozle]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
只凭一袋甜食和你最狡猾的计谋，看看能否击败邪恶的格鲁兹尔。这是一款面向低龄玩家的简单幻想冒险游戏。

[译自 [url=https://renai.us/game/the_groozle]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
